# Copilot Review Instructions

## Skip Files

Do not review or comment on changes to:
- `**/*.md` - Markdown documentation files
- `**/*.mmd` - Mermaid diagram files

## Focus

Review only code files:
- `**/*.cs` - C# source code
- `**/*.csproj` - Project files
- `**/*.yml` - YAML configuration (excluding this file)
- `**/*.yaml` - YAML configuration
- `**/*.json` - JSON configuration
- `**/*.sln` - Solution files
- `src/**` - Source code directory
- `.github/workflows/**` - Workflow definitions (code), but not documentation

Ignore all documentation and diagram changes from review.
